hazards.title: A token is counted as a citation that realizes nothing
A test result is joined to the wrong test case
The results file belongs to another tree, or is stale
The exit code or summary line claims more than the report shows
A declared id is silently missing from the report
A report is altered or replaced after the run
A retired id is counted, or a stale citation goes unreported
`impact` under-reports what a change touches, so a revalidation is missed
